# oTree's sample games

oTree's sample project, for jtree's tests (`server/test/otree-samples.test.js`): each app is played
by its own bots (`tests.py`) in jtree. From https://github.com/oTree-org/oTree, branch `lite`
(commit 4731e6ac46a6dd35b4bd44813933e081ac205965), as `otree startproject` downloads it, with its `tests.py` files;
`Procfile` and `requirements.txt` left out.

oTree is MIT licensed (`LICENSE`), and asks that publications of results from experiments run
with it cite Chen, Schonger and Wickens (2016), "oTree - An open-source platform for laboratory,
online, and field experiments", Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Finance 9: 88-97.
